title: Putin asks for the full account

tellings.quote: then he said, "Please tell me exactly how everything transpired, how it all unfolded."

plain: Kiran Ilum Xenov, whom the episode presents as a former president of a republic within Russia and who says he was taken by aliens in 1997, tells Michels that Vladimir Putin later asked him about it. He says Putin told him, "Please tell me exactly how everything transpired, how it all unfolded." If true, it would mean the story was taken seriously at the top of the Russian state.
